purpose: Derive the exact epsilon^2 coefficient of the localized C-PHYS-M1 cap action for a fixed cap embedding, including simultaneous induced-metric, cap-phase and tangential U(1) perturbations, and derive the corresponding first-order cap stress/current response. Cap displacement/bending and the complete perturbed two-sided junction system remain outside this control block.

cap_parent_action.charge: q_Sigma=m_sigma*q_hat/M6 with m_sigma positive integer and q_hat>0

fixed_interface_path.embedding: fixed coordinate embedding of Sigma5 in WP1C2

phase_norm_expansion.index_rule: all raised indices and contractions use hbar_ab

cap_stress_response.future_israel_residual: deltaJunction_ab=M6^4*sum_s deltaPi_ab^(s)-deltaS_ab; it may be interpreted as a linearized junction equation only after a background satisfying the unperturbed junction condition is established.

phase_equation_density_kernel.on_shell_warning: deltaK_phase defines the linearized residual kernel off shell; setting its divergence to zero as a perturbation equation presumes the background cap phase equation is satisfied.

u1_gauge_control.firewall: This U(1) statement does not address bulk diffeomorphism gauge, cap displacement gauge, patch topology, or global winding-sector transitions.

control_limits.fixed_induced_metric: q_ab=0 gives C2=-0.5*Z_sigma*b_a*b^a, the ordinary Stückelberg/phase kinetic Hessian on the cap
control_limits.no_phase_or_gauge_perturbation: b_a=0 leaves the pure induced-metric response of cap tension plus background winding energy
control_limits.isotropic_no_winding_background: Bbar_a=0 removes all background-winding mixing; q_ab=0 then leaves only -0.5*Z_sigma*b^2
control_limits.no_active_phase_perturbation: If the declared isotropic control disables the phase sector entirely, WP1C2 must not be used to infer a propagating cap mode.

independent_QA_contract.direct_density: Use deterministic Lorentz-signature 5x5 induced metrics and central finite differences of the original non-expanded cap density to reconstruct C2.
independent_QA_contract.stress_response: Finite-difference the exact project EQ-006 cap stress tensor and compare each component with deltaS_ab.
independent_QA_contract.current_response: Finite-difference J_Sigma^a=q_Sigma*Z_sigma*h^ab*B_b and compare with deltaJ_Sigma^a.
independent_QA_contract.gauge_invariance: Apply simultaneous perturbation shifts a_a->a_a+xi_a and partial_a s->partial_a s+q_Sigma*xi_a and verify b_a, C2, deltaS_ab and deltaJ remain unchanged.

what_remains_open: cap displacement/bending or globally justified fixed-interface gauge
normal and tangential metric perturbations outside the local fixed-interface control chart
complete two-sided perturbed Israel/scalar/gauge/phase junction assembly
matter Delta_m observable-source definition and coupling
mu eta Sigma growth and lensing
ghost freedom, kinetic positivity, gradient stability and physical spectrum
forbidden_inferences: Do not interpret fixed-interface cap closure as proof that cap bending is absent or pure gauge.
Do not impose the linearized Israel residual as a physical boundary equation without an established background satisfying the unperturbed matching conditions.
Do not infer a propagating cap mode when the phase sector is disabled in an isotropic control branch.
Do not infer ghost freedom or stability from Z_sigma>0 or from the cap Hessian alone.
Do not infer a 4D observable map, growth, lensing or physical response rank.
Do not authorize solver execution or promote K1-D/K1-E.
